1981-2415-5686-7818.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5686-7818.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

586-864-2034-3125-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2034-3125-6351.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Teval.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-4050-6854--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

3490-4050-6720-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6720-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2232-4022-4541-5705.manaNeeded: {1} if you control fewer than eight Treasures
2232-4022-4541-5705.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven Treasures.
A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
2232-4022-4541-5705.description:
Activate at least seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {7}.
Cast Marut by paying at least {7} gained from Treasures, plus an extra up to {1} if needed.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Hidden Herbalists from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Marut. When Marut enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure for each mana from a Treasure spent to cast it.
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Hidden Herbalists trigger, adding {G}{G}
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
2232-4022-4541-5705.notes: If you control eight or more Treasures, use eight Treasures to cast Marut, which foregoes step 12.

586-5256-5258-5618-7646.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

821-2173-5220-7452.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

57-206-283-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-206-283-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

891-1258-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Abduction triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1251-3259-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7158.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1150-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Melira's Keepers
When Melira's Keepers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

500-1777-3227.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Scrivener and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Scrivener tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a Scrivener token, adding {B}{B} plus an additional amount of {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2. 
Repeat.

413-2060-3705-6701.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying its mana cost.
When Squee enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Squee.
When Squee is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
413-2060-3705-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

791-2290-4029.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
791-2290-4029.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

997-4616-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-4616-6249--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3705-4050-4833-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1306-1393-4050-4986.manaNeeded: {1} if the permanent requires three or more mana to cast
1306-1393-4050-4986.notablePrerequisites: You have a historic permanent card in hand that can be cast using {C} and two colored mana.
1306-1393-4050-4986.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the historic permanent from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the historic permanent cast in step 3 from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 3.
1306-1393-4050-4986.notes: If the historic permanent can be cast for less than {C} and two colored mana, this combo nets infinite mana.

1806-4050-4666-5465.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {1}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Planar Void triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

2573-3946-5155.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

841-2034-4488-4544.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-2034-4488-4544.description:
Play a land card, triggering Dúnedain Rangers and Rampaging Baloths.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the Beast token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dúnedain Rangers and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

2160-2825-4406.notablePrerequisites: Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
2160-2825-4406.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {3} and tapping it, casting a copy of Chance for Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Chance for Glory copy, giving creatures you control indestructible, taking an extra turn after this one, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
At the beginning of your end step, if this is an extra turn from Chance for Glory, its delayed triggered ability triggers.
In response, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, ending the turn and exiling the triggered ability.
Repeat each turn.

751-1636.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {U}.
751-1636.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Shrieking Drake.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm's trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake's trigger, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
